newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway issues new 12-month T-bill of NOK 4.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: Norway issues new 12-month T-bill of NOK 4.5 bln.

text.p: Norway's Central Bank said on Thursday the Finance Ministry had issued a new 12-month treasury bill of 4.5 billion crowns, of which 500 million crowns were reserved for the bank.
The bill, SS44, has a nominal interest of 5.20 percent, the bank said in a statement. Bids should be made by 0800 GMT on September 16. Settlement is two days later.
The T-bill has the registration number 200034.2.
